_comment: Copy to config.json next to ccdash.py (it is picked up automatically) or pass --config. All keys optional.
_ttl: Main-conversation prompt-cache lifetime used to classify rewrites. 'auto' reads it from the usage fields (every cache write is tagged 5-minute or 1-hour). Override with 60 (claude.ai subscription within plan usage) or 5 (API key, Bedrock, Vertex, gateway) if your gateway drops that breakdown.
_multiplier: 1.10 for Bedrock regional/multi-region inference profiles (us., eu., apac.), 1.0 for global. or the Anthropic API.
_aliases: Map the model names your gateway reports (as they appear in the transcripts' message.model) to a real model id so pricing matches. Run ccdash once; unknown names are printed.
_prices: USD per million tokens, matched as substrings of the (aliased) model id. cache_write_* default to 1.25x and 2x input.
